name: Marc Herrmann
imdb_disambiguator: IMDb renders him 'Marc Herrmann (I)' - more than one on the site. Bound to nm8199556.
also_credited_as: Actor (65), Writer (7), Director (4), Producer (4), Editor (1). 4 award nominations. Only the ACTOR credits are staged.
AKA_TO_ADD: IMDb records the alternative name 'Marc Herman' (one r), and he is billed that way on 'When the Blackout Comes' (2026). people.csv already holds an aka for him - check before writing, this may need appending rather than filling.
NOTABLE: The most-credited actor in the database at 32 on file, and now the lead tile on the Popular Actors rail. 29 vertical credits here.
ANSWERS_AN_OPEN_QUESTION: SCANDALOUS. He plays TRENT REXROTH in it (2026). Trent Rexroth is the male lead of L.J. Shen's novel 'Scandalous' (All Saints High). DEA TASKS carries an open item - 'Are the L.J. Shen adaptations (Scandalous, Vicious) official?' - and this is the first hard evidence in either direction: the production is using the BOOK'S CHARACTER NAMES, not just its title. That is strong evidence it is an adaptation of that specific novel. It is NOT evidence that the adaptation is LICENSED, which is the actual question, and the standing rule is that nobody is credited as author until that is verified. Recorded, not acted on.
LAYOUT_TRAP_RECOVERED: Sixth page hit. 'Love Is a Dangerous Dance 8.0 TV Mini Series Previous Jack 2025' then '62' then "'The Viper' Hargrove" - the 'Previous 62' control is wedged INSIDE the character name 'Jack \'The Viper\' Hargrove'. Rejoined; the Known-for block gives the same character in full, which is what makes it safe.
CROSS_REFERENCES: Four titles shared with other PDFs in this batch. Kirby Ellwood is Nora Blake in 'Marry Me Twice, Mr. Grant' (he is Vince Grant), Lila in 'Puck Me Baby One More Time' (he is Alexander Vaughn), and Molly Maguire in 'Doctor Boss Is My Baby Daddy' (he is Graham Weston). Leif Erik Offerdahl is Joseph in 'Dear Husband, Delete My Number' (he is Elijah Williams).
